title: Accommodating state and federal requirements
summary: Accommodation asks whether the relevant state and federal interests can both be respected through a particular allocation of tasks or procedure. Gasperini considers review of damages under state law and federal appellate constraints.
notes: Accommodation is a case-specific method of implementing the governing law, not a free-floating compromise whenever two rules disagree.

sections.Meaning: Accommodation asks whether the relevant state and federal interests can both be respected through a particular allocation of tasks or procedure. Gasperini considers review of damages under state law and federal appellate constraints.
sections.How to work through the question: Specify the state standard, the federal institutional constraint, and which court or decision-maker can perform the required review. Explain why the proposed arrangement preserves each interest under the opinion.
